policy: Only fills columns that are currently NULL; no existing value is modified or deleted.
Every update carries a source URL and a confidence level.
Apply only after human review; run the validation queries afterwards.
sql_template: UPDATE <table> SET <column> = <value> WHERE hardware_id = <id> AND <column> IS NULL;
